How Luke Sullivan connects

  • Location: Metro City — Luke Sullivan's Street Fighter 6 chapter is set in Metro City.
  • Faction: World Warriors — Luke Sullivan is a later-generation World Warrior.

What is Luke Sullivan?

Luke Sullivan is the MMA-styled World Warrior introduced as Street Fighter V's late face and Street Fighter 6's leading newcomer, a Nayshall war survivor in Metro City.
